blurb: The teaching attributed to Zarathustra: one Wise Lord (Ahura Mazda), the cosmic struggle of truth (asha) against the lie (druj), and individual judgment.

events.description: 17 hymns in Old Avestan traditionally attributed to Zarathustra himself — the oldest layer of the Avesta. They preach one Wise Lord, the choice between truth and the lie, and judgment after death. Dating is genuinely debated.
events.title: Gathas of Zarathustra

events.description: Sasanian priests gather the orally transmitted Avestan texts into a written canon with Pahlavi commentary, giving Zoroastrianism its classical, state-church form.
events.title: Avesta codified under the Sasanians

events.description: By traditional accounts, Zoroastrian refugees from Islamic-era Iran settle on India's Gujarat coast sometime between the 8th and 10th centuries — the origin of the Parsi community.
events.title: Zoroastrians reach India — the Parsis

name: Zoroastrianism
